Ivy/trad as a short canonical wardrobe of named forms (sack jacket 3/2 roll, OCBD, repp tie, chinos, Shetland, penny loafers) each tied to reference makers J.Press, Brooks Brothers, L.L. Bean; Take Ivy 1965 and Yale dress study group as codifying documents

Kimono divided into named forms ordered by formality (furisode, kurotomesode/irotomesode, houmongi, komon, yukata) with sleeve length and occasion as attributes; formality hierarchy is consensus-ranked by TPO convention
Down fill power as a measured spec (cubic inches of loft per ounce) that grades down quality but is not warmth; fill weight is the second spec; synthetic fills have no equivalent test
Wool Super numbers (100s, 120s, 150s) as a fineness grade on worsted suit cloth; convention that 'Super' applies only to pure new wool; grade does not equal durability or quality of suit
ISO 8559-1:2017 body-measurement definitions for clothing size designation (ISO/TC 133 Clothing sizing systems): size is standardised as a measurement system, separate from garment kind

HS/HTS chapter 61 apparel knitted: headings split by user (men's or boys', women's or girls', babies') then garment (6101 overcoats and anoraks, 6103 suits and jackets, 6105 shirts, 6111 babies' garments, 6117 accessories) and by fibre in subheadings; chapter 62 woven and 6309 worn clothing separate; shows trade splits by construction, user and material
